purpose: Teach: キヤノン/ジョージア/ミシガン/オハイオ/ジャスコ/早川書房/皇居/東北大学

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがキヤノンの新型カメラを購入されたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad bought a new Canon camera.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gentle opening. Speaking to a child with natural pacing. Slight lift at the end—sharing something she thinks he'll find interesting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとジョージア州の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Georgia.
lines.style: Bright, present-tense energy. Quick words tumbling out. The eagerness of a child sharing something that happened. Small, genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがミシガン州駐在のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad told me about his time stationed in Michigan.
lines.style: Thoughtful, listening tone. Slightly slower pace. She's processing what she heard. Warm and attentive—really present with the memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとオハイオ州の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Ohio.
lines.style: Same bright energy as before. Eager to keep sharing. The repetition feels natural to a child—he's delighted by the pattern. Small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジャスコ時代の通販カタログを持ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad had an old Jusco mail-order catalog from years ago.
lines.style: Quietly observant. A small smile in her voice—amused by the detail. Reflective but warm. She's noticing something tender about Dad sharing these pieces of his past.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと早川書房のSF本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I read a science fiction book from Hayakawa.
lines.style: Sustained brightness. Words coming steadily, with genuine delight. The rhythm stays consistent—he's absorbed in sharing. Open, unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが皇居一般参賀に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad went to the New Year's public greeting at the palace.
lines.style: Softer, more reverent. Slower pace. A note of respect underneath the warmth. She's reflecting on something significant Dad experienced. Gentle, almost wistful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと東北大学のオープンキャンパス行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to the Tohoku University open campus with Dad.
lines.style: Eager words with a slight wishful quality. Hopeful, not demanding. The brightness holds but with a gentler, more genuine underneath—something he really wants. Soft close.
